capabilities: Share notes to general, NotionNext, or custom Notion databases
Map Obsidian frontmatter keys to custom Notion properties
Choose which database to sync to on the fly
Upload local images and PDFs to Notion, resolving Wikilinks and Markdown links
extras: Detailed setup instructions are kept on a separate documentation website, not in the README.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of the original obsidian-to-notion by EasyChris, with added features
motivation: The author forked obsidian-to-notion to add features and support more flexible database configurations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to a Notion database, including uploading local images and PDFs with the note.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of the original obsidian-to-notion by EasyChris, with added features

summary: Fork of obsidian-to-notion that shares notes from Obsidian to Notion databases via the Notion API, including NotionNext blog templates and custom schemas.
